Led by Dr. Wesley Francillon, Papillon Engineering is a dynamic hub for engineering education and related projects. Drawing on a Ph.D. in Materials Science and over two decades of cross-sector experience spanning private industry, federal government, and academia, our mission is to make complex systems accessible. 

As an Associate Professor teaching Engineering Science and Electrical Engineering Technology, Dr. Francillon bridges the gap between classroom theory and real-world implementation, guiding hands-on undergraduate projects and fostering the next generation of STEM professionals through robust K-12 outreach.

<!-- LIVE RSS FEED SECTION                      -->
<!-- ========================================== -->

<div style="margin-top: 60px; padding-top: 30px; border-top: 2px solid #e2e8f0;">
  <h2 style="font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1e1b4b; margin-bottom: 8px;">Live Engineering & Materials Feed</h2>
  
  <p style="font-size: 1.05rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 25px; line-height: 1.6;">
    <em>Curated daily from IEEE Spectrum, MIT Mechanical Engineering, and Phys.org Materials Science.</em><br>
    <strong style="color: #0f172a;">Interested in creating an automated RSS feed aggregator as a Python project?</strong> 
    <a href="rss_feeds.html" style="color: #4338ca; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none;">Build this automated Python syndication pipeline here →</a>
  </p>

  <!-- Feed Cards Container -->
  <div id="rss-feed-container" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 20px;">
    <!-- JavaScript will inject cards here -->
    <div style="color: #64748b; font-style: italic;">Fetching latest engineering headlines...</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Target RSS Feeds
  const feeds = [
    { name: "IEEE Spectrum (Electrical)", url: "https://spectrum.ieee.org/feeds/feed.rss" },
    { name: "MIT News (Mechanical)", url: "https://news.mit.edu/rss/topic/mechanical-engineering" },
    { name: "Phys.org (Materials Science)", url: "https://phys.org/rss-feed/nanotech-news/materials-science/" }
  ];

  const container = document.getElementById("rss-feed-container");
  container.innerHTML = ""; // clear loading text

  feeds.forEach(feed => {
    // Use rss2json proxy to bypass CORS restrictions in static HTML
    const apiUrl = `https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=${encodeURIComponent(feed.url)}&api_key=`;
    
    fetch(apiUrl)
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data.status === 'ok') {
          // Grab the top 2 articles from this feed
          const articles = data.items.slice(0, 2);
          
          articles.forEach(item => {
            // Clean up descriptions (remove HTML tags and truncate)
            let cleanDesc = item.description.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '');
            if (cleanDesc.length > 120) cleanDesc = cleanDesc.substring(0, 120) + "...";
            
            // Format publish date
            const pubDate = new Date(item.pubDate).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });

            // Create card HTML
            const card = document.createElement("div");
            card.style.cssText = "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 0.2s;";
            card.onmouseover = () => card.style.transform = "translateY(-4px)";
            card.onmouseout = () => card.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
            
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #4338ca; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px;">${feed.name}</div>
              <h3 style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; margin: 0 0 10px 0; line-height: 1.4;">
                <a href="${item.link}" target="_blank" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: none;">${item.title}</a>
              </h3>
              <p style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748b; margin: 0 0 15px 0; line-height: 1.5;">${cleanDesc}</p>
              <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 500;">📅 ${pubDate}</div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(card);
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(error => console.error("Error fetching feed:", error));
  });
});
</script>
